📋 Setup Guide
First-time setup
30 minutes, done once forever
You need 3 things: an OpenAI API key to power the tools, a Buffer account to post to social media, and this file hosted on GitHub Pages so your keys stay saved. That's it. No servers, no subscriptions beyond Canva.
1
Upload this file to GitHub Pages Free forever
This is the most important step — it gives the file a stable URL so your API keys stay saved between sessions.

1. Go to github.com → sign up free
2. New repository → name it mpw-tools → Public → Create
3. Upload this HTML file → rename it to index.html → Commit
4. Settings → Pages → Source: Deploy from branch → branch: main → Save
5. Your URL: https://yourusername.github.io/mpw-tools/
6. Bookmark this URL. Open it every day from here — not from your desktop file.
€0 / month
2
Get your OpenAI API key One-time
1. Go to platform.openai.com → sign in (same account as ChatGPT)
2. Click your profile → API Keys → Create new secret key → name it "MPW"
3. Copy the key immediately — it's only shown once
4. Billing → Add payment method → add €10 credit. This lasts 2–3 months for normal use.

Note: Your ChatGPT subscription does NOT cover API usage. They are separate billing.
OPENAI_API_KEY = sk-proj-xxxxxxxxxxxx
~€5–10 / month depending on usage
3
Connect Buffer — post to FB, IG, Threads Free (3 channels)
1. Go to buffer.com → Sign up free
2. Connect 3 channels: Facebook Page, Instagram Business, Threads
3. Get your Access Token: Buffer → Settings → API → copy the token
4. Get your Profile IDs: Buffer → Channels → click each channel → copy the ID shown in the URL

You'll enter these 4 values in Settings & Keys above. Done once.
BUFFER_ACCESS_TOKEN = xxxxxxxxxxxx BUFFER_FB_ID = [Facebook profile ID] BUFFER_IG_ID = [Instagram profile ID] BUFFER_TH_ID = [Threads profile ID]
€0 / month — free plan covers FB + IG + Threads
4
Enter all keys in Settings 2 minutes
Click ⚙ Settings & Keys (top right of home screen) → paste in all your keys → Save.
They are stored only in your browser. They never leave your device. Never go into the HTML file itself.
5
Set up Make.com — 2 scenarios only Free forever
The free Make.com plan includes 2 active scenarios and 1,000 credits/month. You only need 2:

Scenario 4 — ManyChat email capture: When someone gives their email in a ManyChat DM flow → adds them to Brevo → welcome sequence starts. Without this, email leads from comment campaigns are lost.

Scenario 5 — Monday weekly analysis: Every Monday 7AM → collects data from GA4, Etsy, Meta Graph API, Notion → Claude writes analysis + action plan → Notion report + email to you. The highest-value automation in the system.

Full build instructions for both are in the ⚙️ Automations tab of MPW Complete System.
€0 / month — free plan
6
TikTok — use the native scheduler Free
No third-party tool needed. TikTok's built-in scheduler is free and works well.

1. Film and edit in CapCut → export to camera roll
2. Open TikTok app → + → select video → fill caption (from Video Brief tool) → Schedule → pick date/time → Post
3. Or: tiktok.com on desktop → Upload → Schedule (up to 10 days ahead)

The Video Brief tool generates your caption, hook, and hashtags. Copy and paste.
€0 / month
7
Pinterest — pin manually Free
Pinterest has a free native scheduler — up to 100 pins, 30 days ahead.

1. pinterest.com → Create Pin → upload image → add description (from New Product tool → Pinterest tab) → select board → Schedule
2. Pin to as many boards as you want manually — there's no limit

If you get to 15+ pins/week consistently, Tailwind Pro (~€13/mo) adds SmartSchedule timing. But start free.
€0 / month to start

Pick a template from ✉️ Templates screen. Personalise the name and publication. Send from merry@merrypiper.com. One email per week minimum — that's 50 outreach contacts per year.
VIDEO DAYS Full CapCut session → 5 videos scheduled 45 min
One 20–40 min filming session = full week of clips. Import to CapCut → Auto Cut generates 6–10 short clips → apply template → Auto Captions → Beat Sync → export. Schedule all in TikTok native. Post same files as Reels via Buffer with Trial ON.
ENGAGEMENT Post 1 engagement post — "Comment your pet name" 5 min
Monthly minimum. Post a static image with caption: "Напиши името на домашния си любимец — превръщам го в телено изкуство 🐾" ManyChat auto-DMs every commenter. Generates 100+ comments. Algorithm boost lasts 48–72 hours.
Music for videos: Use TikTok's built-in trending sounds for TikTok. For Reels, use Instagram's licensed music library (safe on Meta). For YouTube Shorts, use YouTube Audio Library (free, no copyright). Never use CapCut tracks on Instagram — they're only licensed for TikTok and will get the video muted silently.

Etsy Stats → find listings with high views but low sales → regenerate with Etsy Generator (Reopening Mode) → validate all tags in eRank (500+ searches each) → update 2–3 listings. One hour, monthly.
📦 Packaging insert cards
Reorder when below 20. Print at local shop — A6, 250gsm, matte (~€3–5 per 50). Every package that ships without a card is a missed referral opportunity.
💾 Data backup — last day of month · 5 min
Notion → Settings → Export workspace (Markdown). Brevo → Contacts → Export CSV. Save both to a local folder labelled by month. Protects against accidental data loss.
🔁 Monthly giveaway — 15th of the month
Post: "WIN a personalized wire name — comment your pet's name + follow + tag a friend 🐾" Use Post Generator to write the caption. ManyChat auto-DMs all entrants → added to Brevo → welcome sequence starts. The highest-converting post type for this brand.
📊 Quarterly hashtag review — every 3 months
Instagram → best 3 posts → Insights → check which hashtags drove impressions. Drop the weakest. Use Post Generator → Hashtags to generate replacements. Target 10K–500K posts per tag.
The core insight: Maria doesn't have a product problem, a quality problem, or a retention problem. She has a reach problem. 100% 5-star rating. Repeat buyers. The product converts when people find it. Everything in this strategy is about reach.

The real path: Mix of bookmarks (volume/Etsy), custom orders (ManyChat conversions), occasional collectible sale. Corporate gift orders (€500–2,000 each, 10/year) cover a quarter of the target alone. One Econt-scale order covers the entire year.
4 growth levers — in priority order
#1 CRITICAL 5 TikTok/Reels per week — consistently
Wire art transformation videos regularly hit 100k–1M+ views. The content is already being made (Maria makes art every day). The only missing piece is filming it. One 40-min session per week = full week of content. This alone can take a 0-follower account to 10k in 3–4 months.
#2 HIGH ManyChat "Comment your pet name" — monthly
Single highest-converting post type for handmade brands. Generates 100+ comments. Algorithm boost. ManyChat auto-DMs every commenter → many convert to buyers. €0 cost. Set up once, run every month.
#3 HIGH Etsy reopening — passive search traffic
Etsy buyers are already ready to purchase — it's a search engine, not a social feed. 262 sales + 100% 5★ rating is a strong foundation. Rewrite listings with Etsy Generator → launch 6 priority product types → €1/day Promoted Listings after 30 days.
#4 HIGH VALUE Corporate gift outreach — 1 email/week
The Econt 8,000-gift order proves this works. One corporate order = €500–2,000. Ten per year = €5k–20k with zero social media required. Use Corporate Pitch template from ✉️ Templates. Target HR managers, event coordinators, marketing teams at Sofia companies.

Rule: Never repeat the same format twice in a row. Rotate through these. Wire art transformation videos regularly hit 100k–1M+ views — the format works, consistency is the variable.
01 From One Wire 8–12 sec
"От един тел до тази скулптура…"
Straight wire → 3 fast cuts → final reveal. Most reliable viral format. Transformation template.
02 Guess What I'm Making 10–15 sec
"Познай какво правя…"
Show bending process. Reveal at end. "Did you guess?" in caption. Massive comment driver. Puzzle template.
03 Satisfying Wire Bending 7–10 sec
"Невероятно задоволително…"
ASMR-style close-up. No music, just wire sound. Loops perfectly. Broadest audience appeal.
04 Pet Name Reveal 12–20 sec
"Превръщам Bella в телено изкуство"
Use a follower's pet name from comments. Bending → name reveal. Emotional + shareable. Drives custom orders.
05 Wire vs Reality 8–12 sec
"Тел срещу реалност"
Split screen: real photo vs wire sculpture. Proven TikTok format. Great for pet sculptures.
06 10-Second Sculpture 10 sec
"Мога ли да направя това за 10 секунди?"
Time-lapse of full creation. Speed makes it addictive. Comment: "Actually took X hours." Time-lapse template.
07 Minimalist Art Reveal 8–12 sec
"Минимализъм от метал"
Dark background, silhouette slowly reveals. Perfect for Collectible Art tier. Reaches art collector audience.
08 ★ Comment Your Pet Name Monthly
"Напиши името на домашния си любимец"
Engagement magnet. 100+ comments. Algorithm boost. ManyChat auto-DMs every commenter. Run monthly minimum.
09 Hardest Sculpture Ever 15–30 sec
"Тази скулптура ми отне 7 часа"
Story + drama hook. Show struggle then beautiful result. Builds artist credibility. Story template.
10 Turning Comments Into Art Series
"Превръщам коментарите ви в телено изкуство"
Ask for suggestions → each sculpture becomes the next video. Self-feeding content engine. Community builder.
Current state: 262 sales · 66 reviews · 100% 5★ · in vacation mode. The ranking damage is recoverable — but the reopen sequence matters. Do it in exactly this order.
Reopen sequence — do in this exact order
1
Week before reopening — rewrite 5 listings
Etsy Generator → Reopening Mode ON → rewrite title + description for top 5 listings. Max keyword density. Validate all 13 tags in eRank (500+ searches each). Add 3 new listings: pet name sculpture, bookmark set, couple sculpture.
2
Day of reopening
Turn off vacation mode → immediately post "We're back!" across FB, IG, Pinterest, Threads using New Product or Post Generator → Brevo relaunch email to full subscriber list. Create urgency: "First 10 orders get a free bookmark."
3
Week 2–4 — fill the catalogue
Add remaining listings from the 7 priority types. Reply to all old messages (resets response rate clock for Star Seller). Focus on velocity — consistent daily sales signal to Etsy's algorithm.
4
Month 2 — start Promoted Listings
€1/day on top 2 performing listings. Do NOT run ads in first 30 days — let the algorithm re-index first. Star Seller target: 5+ orders in 3 months + 95% on-time shipping + 95% message reply rate within 24h.

The honest product mix assessment
The product is genuinely rare. Hand-bent steel wire, no machines, single continuous piece per sculpture. This is not a niche product in a crowded market — it's a category of one. No two pieces are identical. The story IS the competitive moat. Lead with it everywhere.
VOLUME LAYER · Daily income
📚 Bookmarks €17–26
🐾 Pet Names €50–150
🌸 Birth Flowers €30–60
Etsy + social. High search volume. Ships worldwide. Drives discovery.
MID LAYER · Core revenue
💑 Couple sculptures €60–120
🏠 Custom word art €40–80
🖼️ Photo portraits €90–250
ManyChat conversions + Etsy. Emotional purchase. High repeat rate.
PREMIUM LAYER · Margin
🎨 Collectible Art €300–380
💼 Corporate gifts €18–22/pc
🏢 Corporate bulk €500–2,000
Direct outreach + followers. One Econt-scale order = full year covered.

Setup — Scenario 5 in Make.com
Not set up yet? Scenario 5 takes 30 minutes to build and runs automatically after that.
Step 1 · Credentials needed
• Make.com Core (~€10.59/mo)
• Anthropic API key → console.anthropic.com → API Keys
• Google Analytics 4 → numeric Property ID + service account JSON
• Etsy API key + Shop ID → etsy.com/developers
• Meta Graph API token → developers.facebook.com → pages_read_engagement
• Notion token + Reports DB ID → notion.so/my-integrations
Step 2 · Build in Make.com (9 modules)
1. Schedule → Every week → Monday 07:00 AM
2. HTTP GET → GA4 Reporting API → last 7 days
3. HTTP GET → Etsy API v3 → shop stats
4. HTTP GET → Meta Graph API v21 → IG + FB insights
5. Notion → Query Content Queue → last 7 days
6. Tools → Set Variable → aggregate all data
7. HTTP POST → Anthropic API → claude-sonnet-4-6
8. Notion → Create Page in Weekly Reports DB
9. Brevo → Send summary email to merry@merrypiper.com
FB token expires every 60 days. Fix: regenerate in Graph API Explorer → update Make.com Module 4. Takes 5 minutes.
